agent_evaluations.detailed_rationale: This OSCE fails fundamental clinical content requirements. It is a TEMPLATE, not an actual clinical case. Zero-tolerance violations: (1) No SAFE-T suicide risk assessment in a schizoaffective disorder case (high suicide risk condition - 10-15% lifetime risk), (2) No Mental Health Act criteria despite 'Emergency Presentation' scenario type suggesting involuntary treatment may be needed, (3) No actual mental state examination findings - only placeholder text 'Mental status examination findings for Schizoaffective Disorder', (4) No medication plan beyond generic 'Australian guidelines' text, (5) No cultural safety assessment. The patient presentation is boilerplate ('A patient presents for psychiatric assessment. Schizoaffective Disorder.') without age, gender, presenting complaint, timeline, or clinical context. Expected answers are templates ('Systematic assessment findings for...') rather than clinical specifics. All 40 OSCEs in this batch appear to use identical template structure with only topic names swapped - this is educationally invalid. A schizoaffective disorder OSCE must include: specific psychotic symptoms (hallucinations, delusions), mood episode (depressed/manic), suicide risk SAFE-T assessment, Mental Health Act criteria if high risk, antipsychotic + mood stabilizer medication plan, cultural safety (Aboriginal/TSI considerations), and safety planning. None of these are present. This requires complete regeneration with actual clinical content, not template text.
